name: openchat
description: A small web chat that can later be dropped into a bigger panel.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @openchat/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @openchat/shared && npm run build -w @openchat/server && npm run build -w @openchat/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @openchat/shared && npm run typecheck -w @openchat/web && npm run typecheck -w @openchat/server
